systems.system: Balcões Únicos de Atendimento ao Público (BUAP)
systems.tiers: 362 installed, 272 of them working, of 634 planned, to be fixed in the municipal and communal administrations, with 10,000 brigade staff nationally (secretary of state for local authorities, reported 8 September 2026)

note: A report of 8 September 2026 on the electoral register update; the BUAP is the territorial administration ministry's counter network, classed central as a ministry-run service centre, though the article says the counters are to be fixed in municipal and communal administrations. It does not say those administrations' offices are connected.
